info.title: MAXR Teamspace API
info.description: Generated from the Zod schemas used for request validation, so it cannot drift from the code.

get.summary: List templates (paginated)

post.summary: Create a template (idempotent)

get.summary: Get one template

post.summary: Deactivate a template

get.summary: Search the audit trail (Admin; read only). Filters: actor, action or module, entity, outcome, date range

200.description: A page of audit entries, newest first by default

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

200.description: Signed in. Sets the httpOnly `maxr_session` cookie and returns the profile and CSRF token.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their role and permissions, and the CSRF token

post.summary: End the current session

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared

post.summary: Change the password; all other sessions of the user end

422.description: The new password does not meet the rules

post.summary: Check in for work session
Check out of active work session

get.summary: Get caller active attendance session
Get caller today attendance summary
Get caller own attendance history (paginated)
List attendance records in caller record scope (paginated)

post.summary: Ask to correct the times of one of your own attendance records (up to 30 days old, one pending request per record). Your manager decides, or HR when you have none, through /approvals

404.description: The record does not exist or is not yours

409.description: The record already has a pending correction, or the times overlap another session

422.description: The record is too old, the check-in is not on its work date, the check-out is not after the check-in, the session is over 24 hours, or a time is in the future

get.summary: Your own correction requests, newest first
One correction: yours, or one inside the approvers’ scope (Team Lead: direct reports, HR and Admin: everyone). 404 otherwise

post.summary: Withdraw your own correction while it is still pending

409.description: The correction is no longer pending

get.summary: Leave types with their policies (every signed-in role)

post.summary: Add a leave type with its policy (HR Manager, Admin). Run the yearly accrual afterwards to create balances for existing employees

409.description: The code or the name is already taken

put.summary: Change a policy (HR Manager, Admin). Send the version you read; balances that already exist are not changed

409.description: Someone changed it since you read it, or the name is taken

422.description: A type without a balance cannot have annual days or carry forward

get.summary: The holiday calendar of a year (default: the current company year), by date

post.summary: Add a holiday (HR Manager, Admin). Holidays are not counted as leave days

409.description: That date already has a holiday

delete.summary: Remove a holiday that has not passed yet (HR Manager, Admin)

get.summary: Your own leave balances for a year (default: the current company year)
Leave balances in your scope for a year (Team Lead: direct reports, HR Manager and Admin: everyone)

post.summary: Create the missing balances of a year for everyone (HR Manager, Admin): pro-rata for joiners, carry-forward from the year before. Repeating it creates nothing new

422.description: The year has not started yet

post.summary: Apply for leave. Working days are counted (company week, holidays skipped); the balance must cover them, taking your other pending requests into account. Your manager decides, or HR when you have none, through /approvals

409.description: The dates overlap another leave request of yours that is applied, pending or approved

422.description: Unknown or inactive type, a half day not allowed or not a single date, spans two years, starts too far in the past, no working days, no balance, or not enough balance

get.summary: Leave requests in your scope (Team Lead: direct reports, HR Manager and Admin: everyone), latest first
Your own leave requests, latest first; filter by status, type or a date range
One request: yours, or one inside the approvers’ scope. 404 otherwise
Who is away between two dates (at most 62 days): pending and approved leave of your direct reports (Team Lead) or everyone (HR Manager, Admin). Reasons are not included

200.description: Leave touching the range, earliest first (at most 2000 entries)

post.summary: Cancel a leave request. You can cancel your own while it is pending, and approved leave only before it starts; HR Manager and Admin can cancel approved or pending leave of others at any time. Approved leave gives its days back to the balance

403.description: Your approved leave has already started; ask HR

404.description: Not your request, or not in your scope

409.description: The request is rejected or already cancelled

get.summary: Your own notifications, newest first. `meta.unread` is the badge count

post.summary: Mark all of your notifications read
Mark one of your notifications read (repeating it is harmless). 404 for anyone else’s
Send an in-app announcement to every active employee (Admin). Announcements are not e-mailed

get.summary: The projects you own or belong to (an Admin sees all), by status and name

post.summary: Create a project (Team Lead, Admin). A Team Lead owns it; an Admin may name another Team Lead or Admin as owner. Members must be the owner or the owner’s direct reports

403.description: A Team Lead named another owner

422.description: The owner is not an active Team Lead or Admin, or a member is not eligible

get.summary: One project with its members

404.description: The project does not exist, or you neither own it nor belong to it

put.summary: Change a project, or archive and reactivate it with `status`. Send the `version` you read. An archived project is read-only except for reactivating it

403.description: Only the project owner or an Admin can change it

404.description: The project does not exist, or you neither own it nor belong to it

409.description: Someone changed it since you read it

422.description: The dates are out of order, or the project is archived

post.summary: Add a member (the owner’s direct report). Adding someone already in is harmless

403.description: Only the project owner or an Admin can change it

404.description: The project does not exist, or you neither own it nor belong to it

422.description: Not an active direct report of the owner, or the project is archived

delete.summary: Remove a member. The owner cannot be removed

403.description: Only the project owner or an Admin can change it

404.description: Not visible, or not a member

422.description: The owner, or the project is archived

post.summary: Create and assign a task (Team Lead, Admin). A Team Lead assigns to themselves or their direct reports; an Admin to any active employee. With a project, the assignee must be one of its members

403.description: The assignee is outside your team

422.description: The assignee is not active, the due date is in the past, or the project is unusable (unknown, archived, you are not in it, or the assignee is not a member)

get.summary: The team board: tasks you assigned and tasks assigned to your direct reports (Team Lead); every task (Admin)
Tasks assigned to you: open work first, soonest due first, then by priority. `overdue=true` lists the ones past their due date
One task: yours, one you assigned, one assigned to a direct report, or any task for an Admin

404.description: You are not party to this task, and do not manage its assignee

put.summary: Edit a task that is not completed (the person who assigned it, or an Admin). Send the `version` you read. Giving it to someone else restarts it as `todo`

403.description: You did not assign this task, or the new assignee is outside your team

404.description: You are not party to this task, and do not manage its assignee

409.description: Someone changed it since you read it

422.description: The task is completed, or the due date, assignee or project is unusable

post.summary: Move a task along todo, in_progress, in_review, completed (and blocked). The assignee moves it as far as in_review; only the person who assigned it, or an Admin, completes or reopens it. Repeating the status it already has is a 200

403.description: You may not make this move on this task

404.description: You are not party to this task, and do not manage its assignee

422.description: That move is not in the transition table

get.summary: Reports the caller may run

200.description: The catalog for the caller's role

get.summary: Preview a report (paginated). Filters differ per report; unknown query keys are rejected

200.description: A page of rows limited to the declared columns and the caller's record scope

404.description: Unknown report, or one outside the caller's role

get.summary: Download a report as CSV (at most 10,000 rows) or PDF (at most 2,000 rows); audited

200.description: CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM) or PDF file

404.description: Unknown report, or one outside the caller's role

422.description: More rows than the format allows (CSV 10,000, PDF 2,000): narrow the filters

503.description: The PDF took too long to render

get.summary: The approvals inbox: requests in your scope, oldest first (Staff see their own requests; awaitingMyDecision=true lists what waits for you)
One approval with its decisions (404 outside your scope)

post.summary: Approve the current step. The last step applies the decision to the request in the same transaction. Repeating an approval that already stands is a 200 with no change

403.description: Your own request, an earlier step you decided, or a step that is not yours

409.description: The request was already rejected or cancelled

post.summary: Reject at the current step; a comment is required. Ends the request

403.description: Your own request, an earlier step you decided, or a step that is not yours

409.description: The request was already approved or cancelled

post.summary: Create an employee with a sign-in account and role in one step (Admin, HR Manager). The account starts pending and cannot sign in until onboarding activates it

201.description: The new employee (status pending). No credentials are returned

403.description: An HR Manager tried to create an Admin or HR Manager account

409.description: The employee code or the email is already taken

422.description: The department, designation or manager is missing, inactive or does not match

get.summary: List employee directory records (paginated, scoped)

200.description: A page of employee directory records

post.summary: Deactivate an employee now (Admin only): the employee and the sign-in account are switched off and every session ends. Nothing is deleted. Repeating the call is a 200 that changes nothing

200.description: The deactivated employee, the number of sessions ended, and the direct reports who now have no active manager

422.description: You cannot deactivate yourself, and the last active Admin cannot be deactivated

get.summary: The top of the org chart: employees with no manager (deactivated ones only with status=deactivated). Admin and HR see the company; a Team Lead sees none, since their team reports to them

200.description: A page of org nodes, each with its direct report count

get.summary: The direct reports of one employee, to open the org chart one level at a time. A Team Lead can ask for themselves

200.description: A page of org nodes, each with its direct report count

put.summary: Assign, change or remove (managerId null) an employee's manager (Admin, HR Manager). Refuses a manager who is the employee or reports to them (a loop), or who is not active

200.description: The employee's manager after the change (unchanged when it is already this manager)

409.description: The version is stale: someone else changed the employee

422.description: The employee is deactivated, or the manager is missing, inactive, the employee themselves, or would create a loop

get.summary: The signed-in employee's own profile, with the `version` to send back on edit

put.summary: Change your own phone number. Nothing else can be changed here: any other field (role, manager, code, status, department, email, name) is a 400

200.description: The profile after the change (unchanged when the phone is already this value)

409.description: The version is stale: the record was changed since you read it

get.summary: One employee. Admin and HR see the company, a Team Lead their direct reports, Staff only themselves. Login information (`account`) is shown to Admin and HR only

200.description: The employee, with the `version` to send back on edit

put.summary: Change employee fields (Admin, HR Manager). Send only the fields to change and the `version` you read. HR cannot change `employeeCode` or `email`; status, manager and role have their own flows

200.description: The employee after the change (unchanged when nothing differs)

403.description: An HR Manager tried to change the employee code or the email

409.description: The version is stale (someone else changed the employee), or the code or email is taken

422.description: The employee is deactivated, or the department or designation is missing, inactive or does not match

get.summary: All company settings (Admin)

200.description: Company name, timezone, work week and integration toggles

put.summary: Change company settings (Admin; send only the fields to change; audited)

get.summary: Company name, timezone and work week (every signed-in role)

200.description: The part of the settings every module and screen may use

get.summary: List shift definitions (every signed-in role)

post.summary: Create a shift (Admin, HR Manager). Times are company-local HH:MM; an end not after the start means the shift runs past midnight and belongs to the date it starts

409.description: The shift code is already used

get.summary: One shift

put.summary: Change a shift (Admin, HR Manager). The code never changes. A shift that is the policy default or has assignments in force cannot be deactivated

422.description: Same start and end time, or the shift is in use and cannot be deactivated

get.summary: The shift assignments of one employee, latest first. Admin and HR any employee, a Team Lead their team, anyone their own

post.summary: Give an employee a shift from a date (Admin, HR Manager). A new open-ended assignment ends the current open-ended one the day before; any other overlap is a 409

409.description: The employee already has a shift on some of these dates

422.description: The employee is deactivated, or the shift is missing or inactive

get.summary: The attendance policy: full and half day minutes, the default shift, and the company timezone and work week it works in (every signed-in role)

put.summary: Change the attendance policy (Admin, HR Manager; audited). The timezone and work week are company settings and are changed there

422.description: A half day is not shorter than a full day, or the default shift is missing or inactive

get.summary: List sign-in accounts with their roles (search, role and status filters)
One sign-in account with its roles

put.summary: Set the complete role list of an account (Admin; audited). 422 when it would remove the last active Admin

200.description: The account after the change (unchanged when the roles were already these)

422.description: The last active Admin cannot lose the Admin role

get.summary: The four system roles with the number of active accounts holding each (Admin)
The permission catalog with the record scope each role holds (Admin; read only)
List departments (paginated)

post.summary: Create a department (idempotent)

get.summary: Get one department by ID

post.summary: Soft-deactivate a department

get.summary: List designations (paginated)

post.summary: Create a designation (idempotent)

get.summary: Get one designation by ID

post.summary: Soft-deactivate a designation

get.summary: Download a file with a signed, short-lived link
get.description: Access: Signed link, issued after the module authorization check

200.description: The file, always as an attachment (Content-Disposition: attachment)

404.description: Unknown, tampered or not-for-you link (all look the same)
